summary: iTonic Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of independent director Bin Wu for personal reasons and the appointment of Kun Yang as his replacement on June 18, 2026. Mr. Yang will also serve on the Audit, Corporate Governance, and Compensation Committees and chair the Governance Committee. The filing includes standard director and indemnification agreements. This is a routine board change with no disclosed disagreement, financial terms, or strategic catalyst. There is no special-situation event; the filing merely documents an ordinary governance update.
